Note: Within the state of Washington, USBR 10 officially follows State Hwy. 20 from Usk to Newport and enters the state of Idaho via US Hwy. 2 at Oldtown. However, both Washington Bikes and the Washington
State Department of Transportation recommend cyclists stay southbound on LeClerc Rd at Usk rather than turning right (west) onto Kings Lake Rd. and crossing the Pend Oreille River to SH-20. Taking LeClerc Rd. to
US Hwy. 2 in Oldtown Idaho as an alternative to the official route in Washington allows cyclists to avoid a tall hill with poor sightlines and heavy traffic on SH-20 just north of Newport. LeClerc Rd. also provides access
to the Pioneer Park Campground located about 2 miles north of Oldtown. Within the state of Idaho, USBR 10 does officially follow LeClerc Rd. from the Washington state line to Oldtown.
